intro: Tucked into the bluffs above Lushwater Oasis in the Barrens, the Wailing Caverns are a sprawling network of subterranean springs and caverns. Originally explored by the night elf druid Naralex to restore lush vitality to the arid plains, the subterranean complex has instead become a twisted haven of bizarre mutations, agitated wildlife, and unnatural perils whose true source remains an unsettling mystery.
